segments.text:
V. 14.
Hearing ye will hear, but in no wiſe underſtand—That is, Ye will ſurely hear: All poſſible Means will be given you; yet they will profit you nothing: Becauſe your Heart is ſenſual, ſtupid, and inſenſible; your ſpiritual Senſes are ſhut up; yea, you have cloſed your eyes againſt the Light; as being unwilling to underſtand the Things of GOD, and afraid, not deſirous that He ſhould heal you.
